notes: Conj 8 (tropical corner bound) is false. P = (19x^2-94x+163) prod_{j<22}(2Dx+2D+2j-23), D=10^5: degree 24, positive coefficients, 22 distinct rational zeros; corners 21, v~ = 20, v = 20. Lean: shapiro_conj_8_9_10_counterexample. Derived from the Katkova-Shapiro-Vishnyakova family Q_n (Q_21 already has 18 corners vs 19 real zeros with multiplicity); the perturbation makes the zeros distinct. Outside Lean: definitional reading only (homEval = q^24 P(p/q); tropical corners = upper-hull edges between strict vertices).
